key_findings: D-Trp accelerates wound healing in normal and STZ-diabetic mice, raising MMPs, VEGF, JAK2/MAPK and lowering inflammatory cytokines and caspase-3.
D-Trp binds HIF-1α (BLI, 5.49 uM), suggesting HIF-1α-linked angiogenesis.
